title: shared dataset document values
description: Values shared by the parts, labels and dataset documents. Cross-document references (asset ids, task ids, part names, classes) are semantic checks, not JSON Schema checks.

name.description: Identifier for ids, task ids, frame ids and asset ids.

class.description: Model class name as it appears in the model's names list.

path.description: Pack-root-relative file path; never escapes the pack.

pack_path.description: Document-folder-relative path selecting another pack folder or file; parent segments allowed.

range.description: [low, high], low <= high (semantic check); a value is drawn uniformly in it.

nonnegative_range.description: [low, high] of non-negative values, low <= high (semantic check).
